title: Friends
lead: Friends' own profiles (preferred roles and heroes) show up as party members. When a friend edits theirs, you see the change.
none: No friends yet. Send a request with their PickGak username.
noProfile: Hasn't made their own profile yet
guest: Log in to add other members as friends and use each other's preferred heroes in party picks.
shareNote: Friends see only your own profile's name (your in-game nickname), its alt account nicknames, and its preferred roles and heroes. So the desktop app can spot you on a friend's scoreboard, name your own profile after your in-game nickname and list any alt nicknames.
